Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

from A to Z phrase

also in every detail, down to the last detail, from beginning to end, the whole thing, chapter and verse

modern

Traupman p. 98: ab aciā et acū mihi omnia exposuit

ab aciā et acū

ab with the ablative of acia, sewing thread, and acus, needle

from thread and needle: in every detail

Literally “from the thread and the needle”, of telling every last detail. Lewis & Short has acia (Titinius, Celsus) and acus, but not the phrase; it is not in the loci collections either, so Traupman is the only evidence here.

Examples

  • Ab aciā et acū mihi omnia exposuit.

    He explained everything to me from A to Z.Traupman p. 98
